name: env-guard
description: A green/red environment badge above the prompt that turns red when Claude's tool calls touch anything that looks like production.

patterns.title: Production patterns
patterns.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive regular expressions that mark a tool call as production, e.g. prod,prod\.example\.com,eu-west-1.

holdMinutes.title: Stay red (minutes)
holdMinutes.description: How long the badge stays red after the last production touch.
